description: The crew feed: one conversation the operator and every bot share, with a sidebar of boards, cells, direct messages, kudos, playbooks, alerts and routines. The composer does the addressing - @bot, @team, @all, !kudos, or a question ending in ? - and an addressed line starts a real run. One store: a board, a cell and a DM are channel kinds on team_messages.
